channel.title: Pier & Point · Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4: The Uber 3 & 4 page now shows that February 2025 press reports disagree on who leases the offices (The Real Deal: Uber and the Warriors each lease office space; Commercial Observer: both buildings are 100 percent leased to Uber). The 2021 completion date now rests on the SF Standard alone; Office Snapshots shows 'Year 2020' without saying what it means.
item.description: The Uber 3 & 4 page now shows that February 2025 press reports disagree on who leases the offices (The Real Deal: Uber and the Warriors each lease office space; Commercial Observer: both buildings are 100 percent leased to Uber). The 2021 completion date now rests on the SF Standard alone; Office Snapshots shows 'Year 2020' without saying what it means. Source: The Real Deal, 2025-02-14 (therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2025/02/14/warriors-uber-alexandria-bag-500m-loan-for-office-complex/); Commercial Observer, 2025-02-11; Office Snapshots, 2022-01-24.
item.source: The Real Deal, 2025-02-14 (therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2025/02/14/warriors-uber-alexandria-bag-500m-loan-for-office-complex/); Commercial Observer, 2025-02-11; Office Snapshots, 2022-01-24

item.title: Correction · Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4: Two 2018 steel-erection entries for Uber's office towers were schedule forecasts shown as events. They are now one entry dated to Mortenson's November 2017 report that steel work had begun.
item.description: Two 2018 steel-erection entries for Uber's office towers were schedule forecasts shown as events. They are now one entry dated to Mortenson's November 2017 report that steel work had begun. Source: https://mortenson.com/news-insights/chase-center-structural-steel.

item.title: Correction · Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4: The record no longer says Uber has occupied both towers since January 2022 on a 20-year lease for about 4,000 employees, or that it leases the entire office component: The Real Deal (2025) says Uber and the Warriors each lease office space there, and SF Standard (2023) says Uber never occupied 1725 Third St and was marketing it for sublease. SHoP Architects is now cited to ArchDaily (with Huntsman credited for the interiors by Office Snapshots), the joint venture to The Real Deal, LEED v4 Gold to Office Snapshots, and completion to 2021 (SF Standard, Office Snapshots) instead of June 2021. The steel-erection dates are now labelled as Mortenson's November 2017 schedule rather than recorded events, and the Alexandria supplemental is dated January 2018, when it was filed. The note that Uber 'never fully staffed' 1725 Third St now says 'never occupied', as SF Standard does.

item.title: Milestone · Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4: SF Standard reports that Uber is marketing the entirety of 1725 Third St for sublease and that the building was never occupied by Uber; an Uber spokesperson says one of its four Mission Bay buildings is currently unoccupied (May 18, 2023)
item.description: SF Standard reports that Uber is marketing the entirety of 1725 Third St for sublease and that the building was never occupied by Uber; an Uber spokesperson says one of its four Mission Bay buildings is currently unoccupied (May 18, 2023). Source: The San Francisco Standard, 2023-05-18.

item.title: Complete · Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4: Both towers complete construction (SF Standard: the four-building campus was initially completed during the pandemic in 2021; no month is sourced) (~2021)
item.description: Both towers complete construction (SF Standard: the four-building campus was initially completed during the pandemic in 2021; no month is sourced) (~2021). Source: The San Francisco Standard, 2023-05-18.

item.title: Complete · Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4: Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4 (1655 & 1725 3rd St) completed, LEED Gold (~2021)
item.description: Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4 (1655 & 1725 3rd St) completed, LEED Gold (~2021). Source: https://sfstandard.com/2023/05/18/uber-looks-to-sublease-fully-furnished-san-francisco-office-it-never-occupied/; https://officesnapshots.com/2022/01/24/uber-mission-bay-headquarters-san-francisco/.

item.title: Milestone · Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4: Alexandria Real Estate's Q4 2017 earnings supplemental discloses a joint venture with Uber and the Golden State Warriors "expected to be formed in February 2018" for "two office buildings aggregating 580,000 RSF, adjacent to the Golden State Warriors arena, which are 100% leased to Uber," with Alexandria's $31.0 million initial equity contribution representing a 10% interest (~2018)
item.description: Alexandria Real Estate's Q4 2017 earnings supplemental discloses a joint venture with Uber and the Golden State Warriors "expected to be formed in February 2018" for "two office buildings aggregating 580,000 RSF, adjacent to the Golden State Warriors arena, which are 100% leased to Uber," with Alexandria's $31.0 million initial equity contribution representing a 10% interest (~2018). Source: Alexandria Real Estate Equities Q4 2017 supplemental (SEC filing, sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035443/000103544318000022/a4q17ex991supp.htm).
item.source: Alexandria Real Estate Equities Q4 2017 supplemental (SEC filing, sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035443/000103544318000022/a4q17ex991supp.htm)

item.title: Under construction · Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4: Mortenson reports structural steel work under way on the Chase Center development, which includes the two office buildings (1655 & 1725 3rd St); its schedule had office-building steel running 2/27/2018 to 8/18/2018 and the project's 'topping out' (completion of all structural steel) on 9/1/2018 -- 6,000 tons of office-tower steel, fabricated by Gayle Manufacturing Co. and erected by Cal Erectors. No report of the actual office-steel dates was read (Nov 20, 2017)
